We have listened and read all your suggestions and have made an update with two aspects of gameplay:

[h3]Final Puzzle[/h3]
We know that many of you found this puzzle a bit frustrating, so we've increased the timer length to make it more accessible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/e72a529fefa17e2c285d937c4e2c74e7d86c4964.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the game!

Vernely yours.

notes.title: Verne: The Shape of Fantasy, Coming August 14th!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that our upcoming dystopian narrative adventure [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] is [b]set to release on August 14th, 2023[/b]. 
Unleash your imagination through the fantastical mind of [i]Jules Verne[/i] as you explore beautiful, detailed pixel art settings and uncover the most coveted secrets of Atlantis.

[h3]Watch the new release date announcement trailer of Verne: The Shape of Fantasy now:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=IuUxLdh2XHI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/h3]
[b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] takes place in the year 1888, where a war against the ruthless “Nation” threatens to completely destroy the land of Hemera. You take on the role of famous author [i]Jules Verne[/i] alongside [i]Captain Nemo[/i] and his crew as you set out in search of the Flame of Hephaestus, an ancient artifact said to hold the power to change the course of history. 
You will have to be careful along the way as they may just discover unimaginable wonders and mysteries.

Only those that crave knowledge and adventure will survive on this epic journey. As you explore, you’ll be able to utilize the IMAG device to rewrite history and change Verne’s fate at certain moments. Solve puzzles in each stunning location and leave no stone unturned. 
Inspired by classic adventure games, you never know what important detail could be hiding in a dusty corner. Pay close attention and discover what was so fascinating about Jules Verne’s incredibly unique stories.

[h3]Features: [/h3]
[list][*] [b][u]Master your Imagination:[/u][/b] Discover and master the “IMAG,” an ancient Atlantean device allowing Verne to rewrite his story and change the fate of the adventure.
[*] [u][b]We’ve Got Company:[/b][/u] Non-linear dialogues create a robust cast of characters in a thrilling story that reflects the human ability to imagine and tell larger-than-life stories. 
[*] [u][b]Unlock Atlantis One Puzzle at a Time:[/b][/u] Utilize side-scrolling gameplay inspired by old-school adventure games where solving puzzles and exploring every inch of your surroundings is the key to success.
[*] [u][b]No Ruin Left Unturned:[/b][/u] Journey through a steampunk-esque world brought to life by detailed pixel art, told through a wide range of environments from the Nautilus’ dark corridors to ancient Atlantean ruins.
[*] [u][b]Historically Accurate:[/b][/u] Enjoy an easy-to-follow narrative that leverages true-to-life information about Jules Verne’s life and world-famous works.[/list]

[h2]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy is set to release on August 14th, 2023. 

Wishlist the game on Steam right now to keep up to date with the latest Verne: The Shape of Fantasy news & try out the demo![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424600/Verne_The_Shape_of_Fantasy/

notes.title: Voices heard: Mouse support added
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings from the Nautilus![/h2]

first of all, thank you everyone who played our demo and provided valuable feedback. This means a lot to us!

We have carefully listened to all your suggestions and we have started to work on them. For starters, we're pleased to confirm that the final release of [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] will include mouse support in both the main menu and the pause menu to enhance your gameplay experience. As a result, you will be able to navigate and adjust options comfortably with your mouse as you could with a controller or keyboard, both in the main menu and the in-game pause menu.

[previewyoutube=SU2Nw25c9pY;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you'll enjoy this new feature as we continue to fine-tune the Nautilus. We look forward to sailing the seas together soon.

Vernely yours,
Devs @ Gametopia

notes.title: Journey into a World of Enigma in Verne: The Shape of Fantasy’s Dev Commentary
notes.notes:
[i][b]The mysteries and stories of Atlantis are waiting to be told! [/b][/i]
Today, Verne dev [i][b]Gametopia[/b][/i] invites players to uncover the wondrous mysteries of a paradise lost to the sea in [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b], coming to Steam and GOG, in 2023. 
Showcased in a uniquely vibrant pixel-art style, [b]Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/b] is a narrative-driven adventure that draws on the life and works of [i][b]Jules Verne[/b][/i], one of literature’s most famous science fiction and adventure writers.

In celebration of its upcoming release, [i][b]Gametopia[/b][/i] shared a look into the game’s conceptualization via an all-new developer’s commentary. Lovers of both old school pixel-art adventure titles and Verne’s fantastical storytelling, [i][b]Gametopia[/b][/i] sought to merge the imagery of the author’s sci-fi writing prowess with gameplay mechanics of exploration, puzzles and deep interactive dialogues. 

[h3]Watch the Developer Commentary here: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=lUHnDfJ9nJc;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/h3]
Set in an alternate 1888, the war against the dreadful “Nation” has reached its breaking point, devastating the land of Hemera, the fantastical world created inside the mind of Jules Verne. Aboard the mighty Nautilus, Jules Verne, Captain Nemo, and the courageous crew struggle to uncover the secrets of Atlantis, the fabled utopia that faced mass destruction from the very power source Verne and his crew aim to locate: the Flame of Hephaestus.

[h3]Features of Verne: The Shape of Fantasy[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Master your Imagination:[/b] Discover and master the “IMAG,” an ancient Atlantean device allowing Verne to rewrite his story and change the fate of the adventure
[*] [b]We’ve Got Company:[/b] Non-linear dialogues create a robust cast of characters in a thrilling story that reflects the human ability to imagine and tell larger-than-life stories 
[*] [b]Unlock Atlantis One Puzzle at a Time:[/b] Utilize side-scrolling gameplay, inspired by old-school adventure games where solving puzzles and exploring every inch of your surroundings is key to success
[*] [b]No Ruin Left Unturned:[/b] Journey through a steampunk-esque world brought to life by detailed pixel art, told through a wide range of environments from the Nautilus’ dark corridors to ancient Atlantean ruins
[*] [b]Historically Accurate:[/b] Enjoy an easy-to-follow narrative that leverages true-to-life information about Jules Verne’s life and world-famous works[/list]

notes.title: Final volume of Hemera Stories: Death of the Ancestors
notes.notes:
Our webcomic comes to an end. You will be able to know the fate of the ancestors, the protectors of the Flame of Hephaestus.

The stories we have told in these webcomics will help you to understand Hemera's world, especially the fate of Atlantis, the main theme of Verne: The Shape of Fantasy.

[url=http://www.julesvernegame.com/comic?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=news&utm_campaign=comic][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/1317cbd4fe0e1756b5573b1827f00b340519e869.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Expanding the story of Verne: The Shape of Fantasy.[/h2]

We've developed a lot of lore in the game. Perhaps too much... although, really.... there is never too much lore! 

We have gone deep into the history of the world of Hemera. That's why we created this webcomic, where you can discover the rise and fall of the mighty Atlantis.

[url=http://www.julesvernegame.com/comic?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=news&utm_campaign=comic][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/93a3134a8724ddb19acf59409ba73e4918698861.png[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy it and that you, future players, fall in love with the rich world created by our imaginary Jules Verne, which we hope you will never forget.

[h2][b][url=http://www.julesvernegame.com/comic?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=news&utm_campaign=comic]Read the Webcomic![/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Extra! Extra! Stories of Hemera is out!
notes.notes:
In “Verne: The Shape of Fantasy” you put yourself in Jules Verne’s shoes to venture into the dangers of Hemera, [b]a fantastic parallel world, built from his own imagination[/b]. A narrative pixel art game that drives you, through exploration and puzzle-solving, to the [b]most coveted secret of the mighty Atlantis, in the midst of a dystopian world war[/b].

[h2]And the discovery of this GREAT SECRET of Atlantis is what this four-issue webcomic series is about... [/h2]

...Which we proudly present: “Stories of Hemera”, a [b]microseries that plunges into the multi-layered lore of the world in which “Verne” takes place[/b], to reveal some of the most important events of its history and add detail to what is already told in the game.

As Aitor Garay (game concept artist and author of this series) puts it: “Verne, video games and comic books... Ain’t it pretty to live in a transmedia world that allows you to mix all these wonderful things?”

We hope you will enjoy the reading as much as we have enjoyed rendering it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38958758/68bfc7ec5cdde3c0a371c45e3401ba8d3c768e3f.png[/img]

Greetings from the Nautilus!
